name: O.R.B.I.T.
description: O.R.B.I.T. – Optimized Real-Estate Benchmarking & Intelligence Tool: a Streamlit framework for NYC property price prediction using a stacked ensemble (XGBoost + LightGBM + Bayesian Ridge), with SHAP & PDP explainability. Supports batch & single predictions.

name: NexHacks
description: Attune is an AI-powered real-time patient monitoring system that analyzes hospital camera feeds to detect discomfort, falls, and unsafe activity. Built with YOLOv8, Overshoot.ai, and LiveKit, it reduces alarm fatigue and supports nurses as a smart second set of eyes.

name: Lawlens
description: LawLens: AI-driven web app for legal document summarization. Secure PDF uploads yield concise NLP-generated overviews via DistilBART. Built with FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, SQLite, and JWT auth. Demonstrates CS skills in ML integration while advancing political science through accessible policy analysis.

name: ai-legal-simulation
description: AI Legal Simulation: Reproducible framework stress-tests legal procedures under AI-mediated decisions. Deterministic rules enforce law; bounded-rational agents probe failure modes, fairness risks, robustness.

name: courtlistener
description: A fully-searchable and accessible archive of court data including growing repositories of opinions, oral arguments, judges, judicial financial records, and federal filings.

name: fairground-fairness-benchmark
description: Independent academic audit of the 2025 FairGround fairness benchmark (Simson et al.). Critically examines reproducibility, robustness under realistic data perturbations, and alignment with legal/regulatory standards (EU AI Act, U.S. anti-discrimination law).

name: procedural-due-process-index
description: Developed the Procedural Due Process Stress Index (DPSI), a novel Python framework quantifying due process degradation in automated decision systems across five legal dimensions (Notice Clarity, Contest Opportunity, Timing, Override, Correction) and detecting failure modes.

name: algorithmic-auditor
description: Algorithmic Auditor: Pipeline auditing bias in loan approval models using HMDA data. Analyzes fairness metrics, explainability via SHAP, and counterfactuals to reveal structural inequities. Bridges CS (ML, data processing) with political science (policy, equity in governance). Frozen baseline tagged for reproducibility.

name: VitaTrack
description: Full-stack wellness & environmental safety dashboard built with React (frontend) and Python (backend). Integrates real-time ZIP-based data for hydration tracking, UV/air quality alerts, weather, disasters, motivational quotes, chatbot, and TTS accessibility. Features color-coded risks, progress visuals, and simplified UI mode.
